added.title: Human Capital Management (HCM) Strategy, Data Program Product Management, Vice President
added.description:
Job Description

HUMAN CAPITAL MANAGEMENT

Our division recruits, develops and rewards the people of Goldman Sachs. Our teams advise, design and implement strategies, processes and technologies that help our people advance professionally, drive productivity and help the firm and our clients achieve superior results. We look for individuals with strong problem solving and analytical skills, innovative thinking and intellectual curiosity who want to make an impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset, our people.

Summary:
Our dynamic HCM Strategy team is seeking an experienced Vice President to drive global, large-scale transformational initiatives. You will be instrumental in leveraging cutting-edge applications and AI to enhance employee experience, deliver quantifiable automation benefits, and build resilient HCM solutions across our firm.

As a Vice President, you will lead strategy, design and delivery of enterprise-wide HCM platforms and solutions critical projects from initiation to completion. You will apply exceptional organizational skills, strategic foresight, and impeccable implementation abilities. A strong focus on integrating systems across the full employee lifecycle – from recruitment to retirement – will be essential. You will collaborate with HCM, technology, and business leaders to define roadmaps, prioritize initiatives, and implement scalable solutions aligned with organizational goals.

We are looking for a seasoned professional with a minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, evidenced by a proven track record of successful product management delivery.

Responsibilities

Articulate and lead the HCM product vision and strategic roadmap, aligning with HCM and business objectives.
Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise-wide HCM systems and tools, from conception to successful implementation.
Lead and empower cross-functional teams to deliver complex HCM solutions, ensuring strategic alignment and successful outcomes.
Develop robust business cases for new products and enhancements, including financial justification (ROI) and key performance indicators.
Champion a data-driven approach by overseeing user research, stakeholder interviews, and continuous product feedback loops to inform decisions.
Ownership and ongoing maintenance of end-to-end data lineage for data products
Foster strong partnerships with Data, Engineering, PMO, and HRIS teams to ensure seamless execution and integration.
Continuously analyze emerging HCM technology trends and drive innovation into the HCM product strategy and roadmap.
Uphold and ensure adherence to governance, data privacy, and regulatory compliance standards across all HCM products.
Strategically manage vendor relationships, encompassing platform evaluation, selection, contract negotiation, and ongoing performance oversight.
Manage vendor relationships including platform selection, contract negotiation, and performance oversight.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Product Management, Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
Minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in product management, leading the strategy, development, and launch of complex, large-scale database and data-intensive products, preferably within the financial services industry or a similarly regulated, fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated expertise in the full product lifecycle management of data architecture projects from conceptual design and strategic planning to successful launch and sustained adoption.
Strong foundational knowledge of data architecture concepts, including data structures, relational and non-relational data stores, data modeling, data warehousing architectures, ETL/ELT pipelines, and business objects/semantic layers.
Working proficiency with SQL and familiarity with modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, including an understanding of schemas, data sharing, security, performance optimization, and data governance principles.
Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Business Objects, Tableau, Power BI) and an understanding of how data products serve downstream analytics and business intelligence consumers.
Proven ability to strategically prioritize, define, and manage a diverse data product roadmap, consistently delivering high-value features and solutions that meet market needs and exceed stakeholder expectations.
Exceptional organizational acumen and advanced time management capabilities, adept at navigating complex data platform interdependencies and driving efficient execution across global, cross-functional teams.
Proficiency with enterprise-grade product management platforms (e.g., Jira), analytics tools, and collaboration software.
Superior executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex data architecture concepts into business value, influence diverse stakeholders, and present effectively to senior leadership.
Highly analytical with advanced strategic problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, capable of identifying root causes, anticipating challenges, and developing innovative, data driven solutions.
Proven ability to thrive both independently and as a collaborative leader within a matrixed organizational structure, fostering teamwork and accountability.
Agile Product Owner/Scrum Master, or other relevant product management certifications are highly desirable.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise HCM systems including Oracle HCM Cloud.
Hands-on or working knowledge of Snowflake architecture, including data lakes, data mesh concepts, and cloud-native data platform design.
Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks, security tools and practices.
Understanding of data security, privacy regulations, and compliance requirements relevant to financial services.
Exposure to data cataloging and lineage tools and techniques

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

added.title: Director, Product Management, Payroll
added.description:
Job Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Director, Product Management, Payroll to join our People Team. This role can be located in New York, NY.

Own the payroll product strategy by defining and delivering the digital product vision for payroll experiences and capabilities across domestic and international payroll processes, including pay administration, controls, compliance, and colleague support
Lead payroll transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, and modernize payroll operations, reducing manual effort and improving accuracy, timeliness, and employee experience
Build and scale payroll products by owning roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for payroll capabilities that support a complex global workforce across multiple countries, jurisdictions, and operating models
Enable operational excellence by partnering with Payroll, HR, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and vendor teams to improve payroll workflows, controls, issue resolution, and service delivery
Enable global consistency with local compliance by designing product solutions that balance standardized experiences with country-specific payroll requirements, statutory obligations, and regulatory considerations
Use data and insights to improve outcomes by defining success metrics, monitoring payroll performance, and leveraging user feedback and operational data to continuously enhance products and processes

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

10+ years of experience in product management, payroll operations, payroll transformation, or enterprise platform leadership
Deep experience with domestic and international payroll operations, processes, and controls , including multi-country payroll environments
Experience building or enhancing enterprise payroll products, platforms, or operational workflows
Strong understanding of global payroll regulations, compliance requirements, governance, and risk considerations
Track record delivering complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives across HR, Finance, Technology, and Operations
Experience working with payroll technology, HR systems, vendor platforms, and service delivery models
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to align business process, technology strategy, control requirements, and colleague experience
Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving delivery without direct authority
Data-driven mindset with experience using metrics, service insights, and process analysis to inform product decisions

BNY assesses market data to ensure a competitive compensation package for our employees. The base salary for this position is expected to be between $130,000 and $240,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base salary if hired will be determined on an individualized basis, including as to experience and market location, and is only part of the BNY total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, discretionary bonuses, short and long-term incentive packages, and Company-sponsored benefit programs.

This position is at-will and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, change in geographic location, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

About Us

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

added.title: EY-Parthenon - Software Strategy Group - Product / Technology Due Diligence - Director
added.description:
Location: Boston, New York

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Software Strategy Group provides top-tier investment and acquisition guidance, strategy, and transaction advisory for the software sector. Every year we help hundreds of software companies and investors make crucial business decisions. On every engagement, you will work alongside our team of former CTOs and CEOs with deep software expertise to learn from the best.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Director with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Software Strategy Group, you will be at the helm of innovative projects, turning client challenges into clear, actionable tasks and deliverables. You'll be the driving force in day-to-day problem-solving, leading a dynamic team, and acting as the bridge between our talented consultants, partners, and clients. This is your chance to lead, inspire, and make a tangible impact in the ever-evolving software sector.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Support clients in development of technology questions to assess investment hypotheses and engagement objectives.
Charged with running complex engagements, framing overall hypotheses and the most important issues for workstreams to analyze.
Act as a knowledge resource in a software economy affinity area and aid in practice-wide business development efforts.
Drive strategic direction of practice-building activities.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Outstanding academic performance, with a bachelor's degree and at least 5 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 3 years of related work experience. 
Ability to make detailed assessments of industry, products, markets, competitors, and customers to identify risks and opportunities.
Proficient in the English language, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment.
Effective organization and time management skills, with the ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.

Other Requirements

Our SSG team members are in the office ~3 days a week.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience in a technology company in a product management or R&D-focused role or in a consulting firm with technology-oriented clients.
MBA or related graduate degree with at least 3 years of related work experience, with a particular focus on client advisory or strategic planning within a professional services environment.
Expertise in one or more software sectors (e.g., ERP, CRM, HCIT, FinTech,).
A demonstrated ability to lead teams on complex assignments and develop individual team members. 
Knowledge of how to leverage AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.

What We Look For

We’re looking for dynamic problem-solvers who thrive in an ever-changing environment. If you can connect business strategy to results and love working with both numbers and narratives, you’re the one we need.

Our ideal candidate is a clear communicator and a great listener. Flexibility is a must – you need to adapt to changing requirements and deadlines to support our clients. If new technologies and exploring the software world excite you, and you have a thirst for learning, you’ll fit right in. We value curious minds ready to innovate.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $205,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. 

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

added.title: Director, Product Management (New Business Experience)
added.description:
About Bestow

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov .

About The Team

The Bestow Product organization is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering exceptional digital experiences that solve real problems. Our team collaborates across Engineering, Revenue and Ops teams to transform ideas into intuitive, valuable solutions that delight our users. We believe in evidence-based decision making and maintaining a relentless focus on customer outcomes to drive product excellence.

This role reports into the VP, Product Management and is open to Remote (US).

About The Role

Bestow is looking for an exceptional Director of Product Management
to lead New Business Experience: the full acquisition journey from marketing handoff through policy bind, spanning Presales, Application, and Checkout. This is product leadership where strategic vision meets operational rigor: owning the strategy, roadmap, and execution for how prospects become policyholders on our platform.

You'll lead and develop a team of product managers across three surfaces, set the bar for discovery and delivery, and partner with senior leadership across Bestow to translate complex regulated-industry challenges into elegant, AI-native solutions. You'll be both a strategist and an operator, comfortable shaping company-level direction with executives and equally comfortable in the details of backlog hygiene, customer research, and roadmap trade-offs.

What You’ll Do

Lead a high-performing team of product managers, setting clear priorities and empowering them to deliver exceptional results
Own product strategy and vision for the full enrollment funnel, aligning business objectives with carrier priorities, agent needs, and customer experience
Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows as a core part of how you and your team operate — from discovery and synthesis to roadmap communication, stakeholder prep, and team coaching
Model AI-native working habits and help define what product management looks like at an AI-native insurance platform
Own the cross-module surface area with clear accountability across the funnel
Lead market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery to identify high-impact opportunities and inform strategic decisions
Run rigorous discovery and backlog hygiene so engineering capacity is matched by a deep pipeline of ready-for-dev work
Own the cross-module surface area with clear accountability across the funnel
Lead partner-facing product strategy for third-party distribution channels (agents, agencies, and integrated distribution partners)
Develop and communicate compelling roadmaps that balance immediate wins with transformative long-term bets
Define success metrics and establish data-driven feedback loops to measure impact and guide continuous improvement
Build persuasive business cases and influence senior stakeholders — Bestow executives, carrier-side executives, and cross-functional partners
Partner with Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Operations to ship products our carriers and their customers depend on
Coach and mentor product managers while modeling Bestow's operating principles, and help recruit world-class talent that raises the bar

Who You Are

10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years of leading and developing product managers.
Direct experience building customer acquisition, third-party distribution integrations, application product at a carrier, insurtech, or fintech
Strong understanding of insurance distribution (both agent/broker channels and direct-to-consumer flows) and the integration surface that connects them
Proven success owning and scaling a significant functional area or business domain from strategy through execution
Deep expertise in product discovery, market research, and translating customer insights into winning strategies
Actively uses AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit, or equivalent) as a daily working accelerant — not just for writing, but for synthesis, research, and structured thinking
Has a point of view on how AI changes the PM role and the PM org — and is excited to help define what that looks like at Bestow
Strong analytical mindset with experience defining metrics that matter and using data to drive decisions
Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders—from enterprise customers to C-suite executives to cross-functional partners
Experience establishing product methodologies, frameworks, and best practices that elevate team performance
Track record of strategic planning that balances ambitious vision with pragmatic execution
Experience in insurance, financial services, or highly regulated industries is a strong plus

TOTAL REWARDS

At Bestow, we’re proud to be awarded for our team members, innovative products, and culture. Our standard benefits include:

Competitive salary and equity based on role
Policies and managers that support work/life balance, like our flexible paid time off and parental leave programs
100% paid-premium option for medical, dental, and vision insurance
Lifestyle stipend to support your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing
Flexible work-from-home policy and open to remote
Remote and WFH options, as well as a beautiful, state-of-the-art office in Dallas’ Deep Ellum, for those who prefer an office setting
Employee-led diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

Recent Employer Awards Include

Best Place for Working Parents 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Great Place to Work Certified, 2022 + 2023 + 2024 + 2025
Built In Best Places to Work, 2022 + 2023 + 2025
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Texas 2022 + 2023
Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Financial Services and Insurance 2022 + 2023 + 2024

We value diversity at Bestow. The company will hire, recruit, and promote regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every team member.

Thanks for considering a job at Bestow!

added.title: Director, Pediatric Product Delivery
added.description:
Overview

The Director of Pediatric Product Delivery of Accreditation and Certification Operations (ACO) is a vital member of the leadership team in ACO and reports either to the National Leader or to the Executive Director of Acute Programs. This role provides leadership and strategic oversight specific to pediatric hospitals, children’s health systems, and pediatric-focused accreditation and certification programs. This role works collaboratively with all divisions of Joint Commission to provide leadership and vision in support of the business.

The Director of Pediatric Product Delivery is responsible for engaging staff, managing and developing relationships, supporting retention and mission expansion within pediatric hospitals and children’s health systems, managing staff within a pediatric pod structure, and contributing to the organization’s safety culture.

Responsibilities

Drive mission expansion and retention strategies within the pod, with focused attention on children’s hospitals, pediatric specialty programs, and pediatric service lines. Oversee all pediatric hospital and children’s health system account types within the pod structure, including freestanding children’s hospitals and pediatric programs within integrated health systems.
Contribute to the development and execution of annual business plans.
Oversee the comprehensive strategy to build organizational engagement and partnership to improve pediatric program retention rates.
Oversee the development and implementation of pediatric-focused strategic account plans that address the unique operational, regulatory, and safety needs of children’s hospitals. Support pod members in the implementation of strategies to drive growth, enhance customer satisfaction, and build long-term partnerships.
Direct a team/pod of Account Executives and Organization Engagement staff supporting children’s hospitals and pediatric programs. Oversee recruitment, orientation, and development of team; contribute to the development of resource documents, policies and procedures to guide pod activities; evaluate staff performance; and allocate workloads within the pod to ensure timely completion of tasks and program goals.
Support on-call activity including availability to surveyor cadre, field directors, staff, and executive leadership. Extra support is needed during significant survey impacts due to natural disasters.
Implement operational activities through all phases of the accreditation and certification cycle by planning, organizing, and monitoring:
Program performance (gains, losses, program growth, program margins, market share)
Survey volume budget and variances
Review and approve pricing adjustments
Processes withdrawals
Review reports to strategically analyze account distribution
Responsible for the uniform and consistent application of corporate accreditation/certification policies as they relate to pediatric hospitals, children’s health systems, and pediatric specialty programs
Facilitates immediate resolution of issues/problems from officers that affect operations
Records Maintenance updates to accounts (denials, reinstatements, UA orgs, history fixes)
Biannual manual reviews by supported program(s)

Participates in the development and testing of pediatric-specific accreditation and certification initiatives. Including product development, education programs, publications in Perspectives and E-dition, standards and survey process development through collaboration with Field Directors and Executive Leadership, and any other resource that support the accreditation and certification programs.
Lead/participate on multiple performance improvement and other teams or committees and advisory groups of the corporation as requested by the leadership team. Facilitate operational changes.
Applies accreditation policy consistently to ensure the integrity of the accreditation process and supports the pod in explanation of policy to customers.
Use reports and data to foster timeliness of accreditation activity and support program performance.
Actively contributes to the successful achievement of pod performance objectives through effective division (SSM, SIG, OQPS) and enterprise team involvement and proactive communication and collaboration as necessary.
Collaborate with Marketing to develop program specific value proposition content, AO battlecards, and other resources to support pod members in mission expansion opportunities.
Senior Leadership Support:
Support Leadership in performing delegated project work
Serve as back up for director meetings and fulfill Director duties when Director is out of the office
Identify critical factors that will affect the outcome of a decision, evaluate options and navigate risk when operational issues arise

Develop pod goals, program goals, performance expectations, and key performance indicators (KPI).
Leading expert on pediatric and children’s hospital supported programs for pod and division; responsible for the direct implementation of all mission expansion, retention, and operational activities and decisions within ACO.
Participate in Advisory Council meetings on-site and off-site as needed. Deliver presentations throughout the year to inform staff, customers, and other divisions about operational changes.
Support program delivery and program enhancements to meet the needs of customers and overall business.

Qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree is required; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Five to seven years of experience within the health care industry in a pediatric-focused role is preferred.
Previous supervisory experience is necessary, including expertise with Joint Commission accreditation processes.
Comprehensive knowledge of financial analysis and proficiency with database management software applications are required.
Willingness to travel as needed, up to 15%.
Must possess a thorough understanding of supported pod and division programs and participate actively in all ACO operational decisions.
Proven ability to drive strategic growth and long-term partnerships with organizations.
Must excel in relationship building and have a customer centric mindset.
Salesforce CRM pipeline management and daily administration to track interactions is preferred.

Equal Opportunity Field

We offer a comprehensive benefit package. For a complete overview of our benefits package, please visit our Joint Commission Career Page

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

added.description:
Company Description
Kalos Ventures is a thesis-driven investment firm that partners closely with founders at the earliest stages. The firm focuses on opportunities emerging at the intersection of AI, automation, robotics, and major demographic shifts. Kalos invests in companies shaping the future of workforce, care, and education as these forces transform how people live and work. Team members collaborate with mission-driven founders and help build enduring, high-impact businesses in these sectors.
Role Description
The Director of Product Management is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading product vision and execution across Kalos Ventures’ portfolio and internal platforms. This role oversees end-to-end product lifecycle activities, from market discovery and opportunity assessment to roadmap creation, prioritization, and delivery. The Director will collaborate with founders, engineering, design, and operations teams to define product strategies aligned with the firm’s investment theses and to guide portfolio companies on product best practices. Daily responsibilities include analyzing product performance, conducting user and market research, setting measurable goals, and ensuring timely, high-quality execution of product initiatives. The role also involves mentoring product managers, facilitating cross-functional communication, and providing structured feedback and guidance to portfolio companies on product growth, scalability, and user experience.
Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in Product Strategy and Product Management, including defining vision, roadmaps, and success metrics.
Strong Analytical Skills for market assessment, user behavior analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
Proven Team Leadership experience, with ability to coach and guide product managers and cross-functional teams.
Solid Project Management capabilities to plan, prioritize, and deliver complex initiatives on schedule.
Experience working with or within technology-driven organizations, ideally in AI, automation, robotics, workforce, care, or education sectors.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
Comfort working in a remote, fast-paced environment with multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or equivalent experience in product, business, or technology is beneficial.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Marketing Agent
added.description:
About Us:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support thousands of
restaurants across North America
, helping process $1B+ in gross food sales
while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees
. Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash. 

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni
. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position:

Most independent restaurants have no marketer, no agency, and no time. They have a diner list they've never used and a channel mix they've never optimized. Your job is to close that gap by doing their marketing for them and not by handing them one more thing to manage.

As Senior PM for the Marketing Agent domain, you'll own strategy and execution for how ChowNow markets on behalf of tens of thousands of restaurants. You'll take a product that today asks an owner to configure campaigns and evolve it into one that proposes them, runs them, and proves what they earned. 

This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Product and will own the domain outright; No direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note:
ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

You put restaurants first.
You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

You celebrate diversity.
You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are.  You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

You raise your hand.
You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

updated.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Product Management

Mastercard Transfer Solution is a global payment service that allows financial institutions, fintechs, digital customers and other businesses to send domestic and cross border payments to multiple end points in 100+ countries. It includes Mastercard Send, our near real time funding and push to card platform, Cross Border Services (XBS) and Bill Pay. Transfer Solution use cases and applications include funding, person-to-person (P2P) transfers, business to consumer (B2C) disbursements, cross border remittance, B2B, Bill Pay and more.

We are hiring a Product Management Director for Mastercard Send. This is a high profile, high impact role within the NAM MC Send Product Management team. This position will oversee and execute on the Send product strategy, manage product roadmap, devise GTM and marketing strategy and ensure delivery of new customer programs. This position will work closely with the account and business development teams to convert market intelligence into new product ideas and innovations, and drive share and revenue growth for Send across use cases.

This role requires partnership cross-functionally with other groups like Global Product, account managers, bus dev, US Product Delivery, LFI and Finance, among others. The Director is a key member of the Transfer Solution team in the North America Region with critical remit to advance Disbursement & Remittance, one of the key new flows as part of Mastercard’s corporate strategy.

Role

Oversee Send product strategy, roadmap, marketing and GTM in NAM. Drive P&L results.
Leverage market intelligence and insights to evolve Send product, value prop and drive innovations
Develop and launch new use cases. Provide thought leadership on product positioning. Drive share and revenue growth.
Devise and execute on marketing strategy with measurable results. Partner across organization to create bundles and synergy.
Support key deal process. Product lead for key CAM segment.

All About You

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, effective product manager. A payment expert passionate about instant payments, next generation payments solutions including open banking, digital transformations and cross border money movements. Candidate should have a track record of delivering results, able to learn fast and pivot, and enjoy working in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

8-10 years of experience, preferably in payments.
Experience in managing digital payments product, especially in fast payment
Strong strategic thinker, track record in developing innovative products or solutions with notable results
Creative and curious. Strong problem solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail. Understanding of financial drivers and partnership negotiation process.
Executive presence. Influencing skills.
Ability to embrace ambiguity and challenges.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

O'Fallon, Missouri: $156,000 - $265,000 USD
